name: Speaker
tagline: A truthful running account of your life, checked against your other bots nightly
description: Borrowing its name from a well-known science-fiction role, it maintains a truthful, balanced account of you while you are still here to correct it. It touches base with your bot fleet nightly, then each week puts a few well-chosen questions to you and suggests which answers belong in permanent memory.
author: BudJohnson
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
